sam: quick report from the handoff soak - we keep seeing ~0.5% of enqueued prefixes become unreachable after a race between lease-release and enqueue retry. they accumulate until TTL. attaching a small trace.

jaya: paste pls

sam:
[lease] release prefix=proj/alpha epoch=233 -> OK
[evict] enqueue id=0x4f prefix=proj/alpha owner=old-node -> ENQUEUED
[lease] release retry prefix=proj/alpha epoch=233 -> OK (retry)
[evict] enqueue id=0x4f prefix=proj/alpha -> already-present (no ack)
[new-owner] bind shard -> ok
[evict] dequeue id=0x4f -> lookup failed (owner-key mismatch)

igor: classic window where owner-affinity on the queue index breaks during epoch transition. two broad approaches: 1) fence token on enqueue (enqueue stores fence=epoch and dequeue validates); 2) owner-agnostic stable keys (global enqueue-id + CAS). both need dedupe fixes.

marta: plus a non-invasive option: reaper background job that reclaims entries that are unreachable for >X seconds. cheap but eventual and can hide correctness bugs.

jaya: tradeoffs: fence token is small metadata and cheap checks but still ties entries to epoch semantics and requires careful handling when tombstones or fresh inserts arrive. stable keys are correct but require index migration and CAS cost on enqueue. reaper is easiest short-term.

sam: proposal: short-term -> conservative reaper (rate-limited, heuristics: only act on prefixes with >2 handoffs in last 30s). medium -> fence tokens with a soft-ack on release: release RPC waits up to 200ms for enqueue ack then falls back and emits release_fallback metric. long-term -> stable enqueue-id + row-level CAS + migration plan.

igor: fencing note: tombstones must bypass fences but still be gated by origin_epoch to avoid old tombstones resurrecting content. tombstone payload should include tombstone_epoch and tombstone_id. dequeue logic: apply tombstone if tombstone_epoch >= enqueue.origin_epoch.

marta: reaper heuristics: prefer not to auto-delete unless we can route orphaned entry to probable owner: consult ownership map, if unresolved mark for TTL prune. Emit orphaned_reaper_actions metric and operator-visible events.

jaya: rollout plan: feature flags per-cluster for release-wait, reaper, and stable-enqueue. dashboards: enqueue_retries, release_fallback_count, orphaned_queue_entries, enqueue_cas_conflicts, reaper_actions. add postmortem trigger if orphaned entries > 1000 for 15m.

sam: I'll push the quick patch: release-wait 200ms + reaper (1% qps) behind flags. will include smoke tests that simulate delayed enqueues and handoffs.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: evict-release-wait.v1 -> canary-7 at 2026-03-24T02:10:00Z

jaya: long-term RFC items: index schema change for stable ids, CAS enqueue microbenchmarks, migration dual-write window, tombstone epoch semantics, ledger vs stable-key decision matrix, and GC bounds for reaper.

marta: agree. also include chaos tests to validate reaper doesn't over-eagerly prune and that tombstones behave under flapping nodes.

sam: thanks all. will post PR link and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
